name: Mermaid
summary: Markdown-inspired text language for diagrams (flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, git graphs, mindmaps and more), each diagram type with its own sub-grammar, rendered to SVG by the mermaid.js library.

level_notes.1: No formal specification; the official per-diagram syntax pages on mermaid.js.org are the reference.
level_notes.0: mermaid.js is the sole reference implementation and its Jison (older diagrams) and Langium (@mermaid-js/parser, newer diagrams) grammars are the de facto formal grammar.
